key_insight: Batching parameter-shift evaluations into each quantum job reduces the cloud interactions needed to train a quantum neural network compared with SPSA.
engineering_relevance: Optimizer design should maximize progress per queued job, not just per shot, to amortize quantum-cloud overhead.
method: Compare optimizers with equal job budgets and shots per job.
Precompute parameter-shift batches for Pauli-rotation circuits.
Test batched training and a structure-aware sinusoidal stencil search against SPSA.
evidence_signal: Simulations with 24–48 parameters required 20–50% as many jobs as SPSA; across three interleaved IBM ibm_fez runs at six and eight qubits, batched training matched SPSA’s final loss in 4–20 versus 50 jobs.
watch_item: Hardware evidence is limited to six and eight qubits, and the test-accuracy advantage was not statistically significant at six qubits.
paper_title: Training quantum neural networks one job at a time
